SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEP_SEQ FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE DOC_TYPE = 'INV' AND BUYER IN ('CNBKSE0001') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, KEY_NO, KEY_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT key_no as LEGACY_IV_NO , key_seq as LEGACY_IV_SEQ , f_split(data01,'^', 1) as LEGACY_PO_NO , f_split(data01,'^', 2) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , f_split(data01,'^', 3) AS STATUS , f_split(data01,'^', 4) AS COMPANY , f_split(data01,'^', 5) AS PUR_ORG , f_split(data01,'^', 6) AS PUR_GRP , f_split(data02,'^', 1) AS PLANT , f_split(data02,'^', 2) AS VENDOR , f_split(data02,'^', 3) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , f_split(data02,'^', 4) AS ITEM_QTY , f_split(data02,'^', 5) AS INV_DATE , f_split(data02,'^', 6) AS UNIT_PRICE , f_split(data03,'^', 1) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , f_split(data03,'^', 2) AS CRT_USER , data04 AS DESCRIPTION FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
